reason: Adds an on-demand Mixture of Agents tool that orchestrates parallel proposer models and an aggregator model for multi-model synthesis.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加按需调用的混合智能体工具，通过并行提案模型和聚合模型完成多模型答案综合。
summaries.en: Adds an on-demand Mixture of Agents tool for DeepSeek Harness that combines parallel proposer models with an aggregator model to synthesize responses.

capabilities: Sends prompts to multiple configured proposer models in parallel
Sends proposer outputs to a configured aggregator model
Retries transient model-call failures with configurable limits
Falls back to the longest proposer output if aggregation fails
